desc:
• FANTASTIC FOUR COLLECTIBLE: Inspired by The Fantastic Four: First Steps movie, every cereal box is a limited edition collectable, featuring characters from the film; Collect all the boxes and crack hidden codes on the back
  • DELICIOUS TASTE COMBO: The perfect combination of chocolatey and peanut butter flavor in every crunchy bite; Enjoy a bowl with milk as a delicious part of breakfast
  • REAL REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER: Ready to eat sweet and crispy corn puffs made with real REESE'S Peanut Butter; This cereal for kids and adults is an ideal pantry staple
  • WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving of this kids breakfast cereal provides 15g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), and has a good source of calcium, with 12 vitamins and minerals
  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy REESE'S PUFFS Chocolatey Peanut Butter Cereal, Kid Breakfast Cereal, Family Size, 19.7 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
• DELICIOUS TASTE COMBO: The perfect combination of chocolatey and peanut butter flavor in every crunchy bite; Enjoy a bowl with milk as a delicious part of breakfast
  • REAL REESE'S PEANUT BUTTER: Ready to eat sweet and crispy corn puffs made with real REESE'S Peanut Butter; This cereal for kids and adults is an ideal pantry staple

  • EASY SNACKS: Pack some kids cereal in a school snacks bag or lunch box for a sweet treat; Sprinkle over ice cream or toss some in your favorite peanut butter cereal bars or trail mix recipes
  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy REESE'S PUFFS Breakfast Cereal, Chocolatey Peanut Butter Cereal, 19.7 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Sugar, REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Dextrose, Corn Meal, Corn Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Salt, HERSHEY'S Cocoa, Caramel Color, Trisodium Phosphate, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Tricalcium Phosphate, Calcium Carbonate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
